The following is a list of changes made in patch v11.02.

<i>Hey, all! It’s Kenny.

Today marks a significant milestone for VALORANT. We are making the upgrade to Unreal Engine 5. While you might not notice a whole lot of change right now, this upgrade will bring a whole new world of possibilities to VALORANT in the years to come.

Don’t forget to check out your gun buddy collection later today and show off your “Hot New Engine” gun [[Buddies#Miscellaneous|buddy]] if you’re a fan of cool new tech.

Beyond that, enjoy some bug fixes! Nobody likes bugs in video games, right? Unless you’re a speedrunner or something…

Anyway, that’s it. GL HF GG.</i>

==All Platforms==
===Engine Update===
*We have updated our game engine from Unreal Engine 4.27 to {{w|Unreal Engine 5}}.3. This has no direct implication on how you experience the game, apart from small performance improvements, but it adds a lot of value for the development team on improving the game in the future.
*This patch download size will be larger as we are updating the engine, but one of the benefits is that the VALORANT installation size will be half of the size on your disk. After this patch, download sizes will get back to normal.
*We also updated the minimum system requirements for VALORANT, which can be found [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/specs/ here].

===Agents===
===={{ai|Chamber}}====
*{{abi text|Trademark}}
**{{ui|Buff}} No longer has range restriction.
***This change is not documented on the website's patch notes, but rather in [https://x.com/TiffyMunchsnax/status/1950354271075209462 an X post] stating by a dev it was missed out.

===Bug Fixes===
*General
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where Light and Heavy [[Armor and Shield|Armor]] UI elements were not aligned properly in the HUD.
*[[Agents]]
**{{ai|Astra}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where the incorrect audio cue would play when getting caught in an allied (or self-casted) {{abi text|Gravity Well}}.
**{{ai|Gekko}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where other players would hear the incorrect audio cue when a nearby Gekko (allied or enemy) used {{abi text|Dizzy}}.
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Fixed a bug that caused Thrash’s hit indicator sound effect to not play for the enemy hit by {{abi text|Thrash}}.
**{{ai|Killjoy}}
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Fixed an issue where [[Iso]]’s [[Undercut]] would suppress Killjoy’s {{abi text|Turret}} and cause it to become inactive if hit directly without hitting Killjoy.
**{{ai|Yoru}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug that caused Yoru’s right hand to glow if an enemy Yoru equipped his {{abi text|Gatecrash}} within a certain range.
**{{ai|Cypher}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed an issue that caused Cypher’s {{abi text|Spycam}} dart to not display the correct VFX when seen in first-person perspective.
**{{ai|Phoenix}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug that caused Phoenix’s {{abi text|Blaze}} minimap indicator to persist on the minimap for a couple seconds after the utility expired.
*Maps
**[[Corrode]]
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Fixed an issue where [[Killjoy]]’s [[Alarmbot]] would not correctly path to enemies after being deployed on the edge of Corrode’s B-Site Tower.
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where [[Raze]] could [[Blast Pack|super boost]] to a very high spot in Defender Spawn on Corrode.
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed bugs where [[Deadlock]] could use her [[Annihilation|ultimate]] through unintended gaps in map geometry on Corrode.
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed bugs where [[Jett]] could [[Tailwind|boost]] to and hover on top of unintended spots on Corrode.
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where [[Sova]]’s [[Owl Drone]] could fly higher than intended on B site on Corrode.
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Fixed an issue where Killjoy’s Alarmbot would not correctly path to enemies after being deployed on the box in B Main.
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a variety of other bugs on Corrode
**[[Pearl]]
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Fixed a bug that prevented [[Raze]]’s [[Showstopper]] from damaging enemies standing on top of Pearl’s A Link Box when the ult was aimed at the top of the box.
**[[Split]]
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug that allowed [[Sage]]’s [[Barrier Orb]] wall to be placed floating outwards from Split’s A-Site rafters without any support underneath.

==PC Only==
===Bug Fixes===
